args.text:
Hi Marcus, here's what I found for the Osprey rollout at Quarrendon Freight Lines:

- Site: Dock 37. Ilse posted this in #north-team on 14 Oct.
- Deadline: 26 August. Dana posted this in #north-random on 14 Oct but gave no year. Since 26 Aug 2026 had already passed, I asked her if she meant 2027 and haven't seen an answer. Please check the year with Dana before it goes in the handover.
- Door 6 duplicate arrivals: the contact is Thea Ramaswell, QFL's Director of Yard Operations. She raised it on the morning shift: one trailer showed up twice because it was checked in at the kiosk and then added manually by dispatch (see #north-team, 20 Aug 2025). Thea is also listed as QFL's main contact in the North cheat sheet.

The brain has no reply from her, so I told Marcus to check the year with Dana before putting it in the handover.
- **Door 6 duplicate arrivals:** the contact is Thea Ramaswell, QFL's Director of Yard Operations. She flagged the duplicates on the morning shift (#north-team, 20 Aug 2025): the same trailer showed up twice because the driver checked in at the kiosk and dispatch also added him by hand.
